_comment: Synthetic marble-race example (illustrative, not a production round). The finishing order is fully seed-derived — one draw at label 'order' picks the index into the canonical 8-permute-3 = 336 orderings. Feed it to verify.html or `node examples/verify-example.mjs examples/marble-verified.json` — it reproduces order=green,red,white (index 106), and the verdict is VERIFIED.
